These unmodified runtime dependencies are included because this execution environment lacks xeCJK. They come from the free TeX Live 2024 final package archive:

- xeCJK: `https://ftp.math.utah.edu/pub/tex/historic/systems/texlive/2024/tlnet-final/archive/xecjk.tar.xz`, SHA-256 `3975a09d07169e9c2c3e66b85990a76de6879e635bf428ddfee17118233a2bd4`.
- ctexhook/ctexpatch: `https://ftp.math.utah.edu/pub/tex/historic/systems/texlive/2024/tlnet-final/archive/ctex.tar.xz`, SHA-256 `2d8e9bf9ffa0fe0588caf425f2cb8cef3d642b99d7ca54e8fd56feae7ab48f98`.

The package headers retain their authors and LPPL notices. Complete corresponding packages, source and documentation are available in the same TeX Live archive (`xecjk.source.tar.xz`, `xecjk.doc.tar.xz`, `ctex.source.tar.xz`, `ctex.doc.tar.xz`). No package file was modified. Other LaTeX runtime dependencies and fonts remain system dependencies; no fonts are redistributed here.

The current CTAN xeCJK 3.10.6 requires a newer LaTeX/expl3 than this environment. It was inspected but is not used or included. The 2024 package supports the installed 2024 LaTeX kernel.
